svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hot-wire cut NACA 2412 cores: root chord 310, tip chord 250, panel 1,180 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Keep the 30 % chord line straight: it is the spar line, square to the root rib.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rout a 22 channel on the spar line and bond in the carbon spar, 1,160 long, flush with the root.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set two 3 mm ply hardpoints in the lower skin over the boom pylon, 490 out from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay a 10 mm conduit from the pylon to the root for the boom wires; servo bay behind the spar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Glass both sides; glue the 3 mm ply root rib with the 20 joiner hole and an M5 insert at 70 % chord.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the aileron free at 75 % chord from 700 to 1230 out; hinge on tape.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make the left panel as a mirror image; the left panel also takes the pitot tube.
